_why: Every exemption carries its own reason string, in the repo, next to the rule it suspends. scripts/prop-rubric.json exists for exactly this purpose, and health-baseline._raises exists because a justification that lives only in a commit message is effectively lost. An entry here suspends the NAMED rules for that component and nothing else; the item still appears in OPEN_ITEMS.md under 'Exempted' with this reason attached, so a suspension is visible rather than invisible.
_source: The component lists are quoted from STYLE_GUIDE.md § Layout Purity § Exemptions and from docs/BEST_PRACTICES.md §8. Adding a component here without a matching sentence in one of those documents is a policy change, not an exemption — take it to Peter.
_thirdPartyPrimitives: UI-primitive packages only. d3-* is deliberately absent: BEST_PRACTICES §8 makes d3 math-only ('d3 is math only, Solid owns the DOM'), and math inside a Composite breaks nothing. @solid-primitives/* is absent for the same reason — those are reactive hooks, not DOM primitives.

Layout.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 1 — the Layout family IS the arrangement vocabulary and is required to declare flex/grid/overflow directly.

ButtonGroup.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 1 + ruling 5 (2026-07-14) — layout-exempt but DEPRECATED-as-such; its runtime gap/orientation props are legacy and stay working.

Toast.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 3 — overlay control; keeps its position: absolute|fixed anchoring only. Its internal rows and columns are NOT exempt, which is why 'intrinsic' is absent from this list.

PopoverMenu.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 3 — overlay control, anchoring only.

Dropdown.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 3 — overlay control, anchoring only.

Tooltip.reason: STYLE_GUIDE § Layout Purity § Exemptions 3 — overlay control, anchoring only.
